answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 154162 Country: INDIA Title: Is gargling obligatory in ghusl or pouring water into the mouth without gargling is sufficient? Question: Is gargling obligatory in ghusl or pouring water into the mouth without gargling is sufficient? Answer ID: 154162 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1447/1329/B=1/1439) Gargling is not obligatory in ghusl. If one rinses one’s mouth extensively and water reaches up to the throat then it is enough. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
